text:
Maya: idea — add a staged_apply mode to runtime-config so we can roll settings by percentage with telemetry gates and auto-rollback.
Devin: +1. main concern: quota and routing effects when cohort hits expensive pools. do we pre-reserve?
Sanjay: no pre-reserve. run shadow routing and sample real requests. pick cohorts across tenant size and latency buckets to avoid skew.
Priya: console should show a live preview: cohort map, projected QPS change, and small trace samples. tweak cohort_pct & eval_window before commit.
Alex: add apply_id and optimistic-merge, otherwise concurrent applies collide. also return an idempotency token.
Maya: include dry_run that emits eval telemetry but does not flip routing. useful for safety preview.
Devin: staged_apply sketch: cohort_pct, metrics[], eval_window_mins, dry_run, auto_rollback thresholds. API returns apply_id + simulator_token.
Sanjay: sampling key = hash(tenant_id||path) with controllable seed for reproducible cohorts and replay.
Priya: UX: dry_run overlays heatmap and safety score (variance + sample size). add "historical replay" to simulate past traffic.
Alex: quota hook: if cohort pushes load to GPU pool, signal quota service. auto-throttle growth if pool_util > 0.75 and pause rollouts.
Maya: backpressure should pause growth, notify owners, and append audit event.
Devin: start metrics small: error_rate, latency_p50, cost_per_1k_tokens. rollback if error_rate > 1.5x baseline or latency_p50 > +20%.
Sanjay: limit traces: default 10% of cohort for traces, 100% for scalar metrics. helps control observability cost.
Priya: console controls: start/pause, growth schedule (5->20->100), manual override, immediate rollback, replay.
Alex: security: simulator tokens must be ACL-scoped and TTL'd; never expose raw logs.
Maya: pseudo API: POST /api/v1/configs/:id/apply { staged_apply: { cohort_pct:5, metrics:["error_rate","latency_p50","cost_per_1k_tokens"], evaluation_window_mins:30, dry_run:false, auto_rollback:{"error_rate":0.02} } }
Devin: who rolls back? central controller with owner notify, but surface explain log and allow manual override.
Sanjay: agree — decision logs + snapshot of metrics at rollback time.
Priya: UX: predicted roll-forward timeline and one-click rollback; persist audit entries for compliance.
ops-bot: created ticket ROLL-4321 and assigned to @Maya and @Sanjay.
Maya: I'll draft RFC tomorrow. volunteers for telemetry sampling and quota hooks?
Devin: I can do quota integration.
Sanjay: telemetry and rollback thresholds.
Priya: I'll drop console mocks in #design.
Alex: I'll implement apply_id/merge contract and idempotency tests.
Maya: thanks — RFC targeted next week :thumbsup:
